annotations.title: Generate AWS profiles from Identity Center assignments

description: Write [profile ...] sections into the AWS config file for IAM Identity Center account/role assignments (after aws_login_start with ssoSession). Default: every assignment, capped at 200 (the rest are returned as `dropped`); or pass `selection`. Names default to '{accountName}-{roleName}', with the account ID inserted on a clash ('prod-111111111111-Admin'). Each section carries a `managed-by: aws-mcp` marker; a section without it is never modified -- a name clash with one is reported in `skipped`. `region` is written only when a profile is created. Use dryRun to preview. Selections are checked against the live assignments; IAM stays the authority.

dryRun.description: Report what would be written without touching the file.

region.description: Default region written into each new profile. Default: the sso-session's sso_region.

selection.description: Which account/role pairs to write. Default: every assignment (capped at 200; pass a selection beyond that).

ssoSession.description: sso-session name logged in via aws_login_start.

name: aws_sso_generate_profiles
